title: No display after update to Android 10
body:
Using a Note9, FreeStyle Libre, and an MiaoMiao2.

Everything worked fine up until the update to Android 10.

According to the Event Log it is steadily collecting data, but nothing will display. It is has been like this for 2days.

I have updated to the latest nightly build.

Could the OOPAlgorithm be the source of the problem ? The phone's device maintenance is showing that it keeps crashing. If that is the problem, any chance that you can provide a link to download a fresh copy and I'll delete the one I have, reinstall the new copy.

Or is there something else that I'm missing?


Thanks in advance for any help you that you offer.
